evidence.claim: Nanni progetta motori marini da 10 a 2200 cv e generatori fino a 800 kW per yacht e navi commerciali in 90 paesi.
evidence.quote: Nanni designs and develops complete marine solutions including engines from 10 to 2200 hp, marine generators from 5 to 800 kW, manoeuvring systems and interfaces. || Nanni distributes its products through its sales and service network in 90 countries around the world. It relies on a solid network of almost 850 qualified partners. || Delivers all essential systems and components required for a fully integrated and operational engine room on yachts and commercial vessels
